pages.text: SYN Market Wire analyst note on Dhahabu Bank (SYN). The analyst set a twelve-month target price of SYN Sh 60.81 for DHA1. The note cites steady demand in the bank sector and cost control at Dhahabu Bank (SYN). Officials declined to comment on whether further changes were planned. Industry groups welcomed the clarity but asked for more investor education. Analysts at several brokerages said they expected conditions to stay stable through the quarter. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
